title: Figure 5.5: Rendering of Fusion Ship II, a 750-MWe IEC fusion-powered spacecraft
description: Color computer rendering of a long spacecraft against a starfield, with a crew module at left, twin reactor assemblies with pink thruster housings and purple ion exhaust plumes. Captioned 'Figure 5.5. Image of a Fusion II Spaceship, a 750-MWe IEC Fusion-Powered Manned Spacecraft With Ion Thruster Propulsion' under the heading 'Space Propulsion'. Accompanying text describes a 300-meter, 500-metric-ton vehicle using D-3He IEC reactors and Traveling Wave Direct Energy Convertors.
